name: @glowplug/supacharger-cli
description: Developer CLI for managing Supacharger locally.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/bin/cli.js', 0o755)"
scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

author: sharpi_sh @ Glowplug.studio
